title: Chapter 1880: Manifest Shore Immortal Plant (II)
content:
Chapter 1880: Manifest Shore Immortal Plant (II)

Unable to contain himself any longer, Yinxin stepped forward and urged, "I understand that your family lives far away and cannot easily tend this spirit root. But that is easily solved. The [Small-Leaf Manifest Shore Immortal Plant] flowers far more quickly than the [Solitary White Brahma Thicket]. I cultivate Earth Virtue and know a few ways to care for spirit roots... Simply leave it to me. Whenever it blooms or its leaves are harvested, I will divide them equally and send your family's share over!"

He bowed repeatedly as he said, "That way, we would both be pleased. Wouldn't that be best?"

His proposal was not unreasonable, and Li Ximing looked tempted. But Li Zhouwei's golden eyes showed little sign of wavering. He said with a smile, "You are very considerate of my family, fellow Daoist. But with something this precious, why should two people share it when one could have it all? Aren't you afraid I might go back, bring a few helpers, and deal with you as well? Then I wouldn't have to share it with anyone."

Yinxin's expression changed abruptly. He looked up and replied, "The King of Wei is honorable..."

The young man gave him no chance to continue. His eyes gleamed in the cavern, lending him a sinister, menacing air as he smiled. "Honorable? I may dare say so, but would you dare believe me?"

Yinxin considered his words for a moment. Clearly unwilling to offend him, he finally sighed, unable to find anything else to say. "If your highness insists on cutting it down, then please proceed!"

Li Zhouwei turned back to the plant. He first picked and put away the four white blossoms, then gently turned his palm upward.

An invisible object appeared in his palm. Though it had no form, its energy washed over them like the scorching sun, leaving their mouths and throats dry.

It was [Hidden Plunder Gold]!

A gift from the White Dragon Crown Prince, it had formed when the essence of Supreme Yang fell into the Eastern Sea. It was an orthodox Supreme Yang spirit item!

Li Zhouwei held it between two fingers and slashed at the Lesser Yang spirit root before him.

Light filled the space in an instant. Leaves drifted down like a jade bottle falling and shattering. Green burst through the white, and small beads rolled and scattered across the ground. It was like the setting sun shining through a tree's shadow, casting mottled light.

Only then came a series of thuds and the sight of seawater pouring forth. Three colors spilled from the light. Li Ximing looked down to find pale-blue Converging Water surging in, already covering the tops of his boots.

He exclaimed in admiration and swept his sleeve over the white beads rolling across the ground. As soon as the beads, large and small, entered his sleeve, they melted into a pool.

Li Ximing’s eyes lit up as he said, "A Purple Mansion Realm spirit item of [Lesser Yang], [Supreme Eave Brilliance]!"

Li Zhouwei briefly closed his eyes and drew [Hidden Plunder Gold] back into his Juque acupoint. Six pale-white objects resembling scales appeared in his hand.

He openly displayed them. "[Dao-Gazing Scales], spirit materials of [Radiant Essence]."

The [Small-Leaf Manifest Shore Immortal Plant] had become a fist-sized piece of dead wood, lying in the shallow Converging Water. Rogue Cultivator Yinxin looked somewhat downcast as he picked it up.

"This became a [Solitary White Brahma Thicket], and is now [Solitary White Brahma Wood], another [Lesser Yang] item. Your highness is truly skilled. Using a Supreme Yang spirit item to separate it was a fitting end for it!"

He was right. Setting aside how rare Supreme Yang spirit items were, Li Zhouwei's seemingly casual slash had drawn heavily on his own Dao conduct and cultivation. It had been no simple feat.

Li Ximing and Li Zhouwei exchanged a glance and nodded slightly. Li Zhouwei separated three of the [Dao-Gazing Scales] and handed them to Rogue Cultivator Yinxin, settling their division.

Li Ximing then said, "Fellow Daoist, since you are here, let us divide Shehu's possessions as well."

He took out the storage pouch and showed it to Rogue Cultivator Yinxin before opening it with his divine ability. Though the spirit items that poured out formed a small pile, the things of real value could be gathered with a sweep of divine ability and divided into six portions.

Two were cultivation techniques. One was the [Mountains Gazing South Scripture], for attaining the [Orthodox Wood] divine ability [Back Facing South]. The other was the [Dao Fire Merging Heart Scripture], for attaining the [Merging Fire] divine ability [Seizing Amid Peril].

Both were excellent and rare Purple Mansion Realm cultivation techniques. This was especially true of the [Dao Fire Merging Heart Scripture]. As an ancient technique, its grade could no longer be discerned, but it was written on a crimson-gold scroll and was clearly no ordinary work.

An unexpected delight!

Of the four remaining items, one was a piece of decayed wood, black as ink and hard as iron. It was likely [Wood Sacrifice Iron], a spirit wood of [Orthodox Wood]. Another rippled like water and was dark green in color. It was the [Clear Profound Coffin] that Li Ximing had long had his eye on!

The other two were spirit materials. One was a [Rising Warmth Stone] of [Dry Fire], which Li Ximing had obtained before. The other was an [Under-Neck Feather], a material his family knew well.

The former was needed to cultivate [Back Facing South], which was understandable. But seeing the latter, Li Ximing felt a little uneasy.

"I've spent quite a few [Under-Neck Feathers] over the years. He may have traded for this one from someone else..."

This was no small fortune for a Purple Mansion Realm cultivator, but for a demonic creature who had possessed a spirit root for so many years, it was rather meager. Li Zhouwei grew more suspicious but said nothing.

Li Ximing stepped forward with a smile. "I hear you have a portion of [Clear Profound Coffin], fellow Daoist. I would offer one of the spirit materials from my share and two [Dao-Gazing Scales] in exchange. Would you be interested?"

Yinxin considered the offer for a moment, then said, "Shehu already had one portion. Since you are asking me as well, you must need quite a few. Feel free to take the [Clear Profound Coffin] from his belongings..."

There was no hiding it, so Li Ximing nodded with a smile. Yinxin had hesitated, but the [Clear Profound Coffin] was of no use to him. In the end, he nodded and took a jade box from his sleeve.

"Very well!"

With two portions of [Clear Profound Coffin] secured, Li Ximing felt reassured. He made copies of the cultivation techniques, and they left together. To his surprise, clouds and mist rose beneath their feet as the treasured land collapsed.

A Stable Earth divine ability.

Li Ximing was a little taken aback. Li Zhouwei immediately stared at Yinxin, but the Daoist Master waved a hand. "Neither of us has any use for this place, but traces of the spirit root's aura remain. There is no need to leave it intact... This way, some Daoist Master won't find it, notice something amiss, and use it to track us down."

His divine ability had stirred for only an instant, yet in that moment it had destroyed the ingeniously formed treasured land, a place seldom seen in a thousand years. Now, avoiding Li Zhouwei's gaze, he turned and cupped his hands. "Fellow Daoists, may fate bring us together again!"

As Yinxin's figure drifted away, Li Ximing turned to Li Zhouwei and sighed. "Working with him... might not have been a bad choice. The [Small-Leaf Manifest Shore Immortal Plant] was a veritable treasure trove compared to the [Solitary White Brahma Thicket]. If it produced one blossom every two years, it would have been worth as much as [Zhen Tao Residence]!"

Though dark thoughts filled Li Zhouwei's mind, he wore an easy smile as he said, "That man is treacherous and cunning. I don't trust him... If war truly breaks out between north and south, he could make any excuse he pleased. Could we cross the sea each time to confront him? Better to settle it once and for all."

Li Ximing could only nod. Li Zhouwei continued as though nothing were amiss. "Granduncle, you still need to collect spirit items and tie up the remaining matters here. I will take the [Heavenly Nurturing Urn] back first, in case anything goes wrong."

Though Li Ximing saw no reason to expect trouble, he handed him the spirit treasure. Li Zhouwei took it, bid him farewell, and entered the great void, his thoughts growing colder.

Let me take a good look... and see what secret is hidden here!
